name: Relation.RelatesInSteps.head_induction_on
lines: motive : (a : α) → (n : ℕ) → RelatesInSteps r a b n → Prop
h : RelatesInSteps r a b n
hhead : ∀ {a c : α} {n : ℕ} (h' : r a c) (h : RelatesInSteps r c b n), motive c n h → motive a (n + 1) ⋯
motive : (a_1 : α) → (n : ℕ) → RelatesInSteps r a_1 a n → Prop
hhead : ∀ {a_1 c : α} {n : ℕ} (h' : r a_1 c) (h : RelatesInSteps r c a n), motive c n h → motive a_1 (n + 1) ⋯
hstep : RelatesInSteps r a t' m
∀ {motive : (a : α) → (n : ℕ) → RelatesInSteps r a t' n → Prop},
(∀ {a c : α} {n : ℕ} (h' : r a c) (h : RelatesInSteps r c t' n), motive c n h → motive a (n + 1) ⋯) →
motive : (a : α) → (n : ℕ) → RelatesInSteps r a b' n → Prop
hhead : ∀ {a c : α} {n : ℕ} (h' : r a c) (h : RelatesInSteps r c b' n), motive c n h → motive a (n + 1) ⋯
⊢ ∀ {a c : α} {n : ℕ} (h' : r a c) (h : RelatesInSteps r c t' n), motive c (n + 1) ⋯ → motive a (n + 1 + 1) ⋯

steps.tactic:
induction h with
| refl => exact hrefl
| tail t' b' m hstep hrt'b' hstep_ih =>
  apply hstep_ih
  · exact hhead hrt'b' _ hrefl
  · exact fun h1 h2 ↦ hhead h1 (.tail _ t' b' _ h2 hrt'b')
exact fun h1 h2 ↦ hhead h1 (.tail _ t' b' _ h2 hrt'b')
